pairs: Now there was a man among the Pharisees,
He went to Jesus at night,
scimus quia a Deo venisti magister,
we know that you have arrived as a teacher from God.
nemo enim potest hæc signa facere,
For no one would be able to accomplish these signs,
Jesus responded and said to him,
unless one has been reborn anew,
he is not able to see the kingdom of God.”
“How could a man be born when he is old?
numquid potest in ventrem matris suæ iterato introire et renasci?
he cannot enter a second time into his mother’s womb to be reborn?”
nisi quis renatus fuerit ex aqua,
unless one has been reborn by water and the Holy Spirit,
non potest introire in regnum Dei.
he is not able to enter into the kingdom of God.
Quod natum est ex carne, caro est:
What is born of the flesh is flesh,
et quod natum est ex spiritu, spiritus est.
and what is born of the Spirit is spirit.
You should not be amazed that I said to you:
The Spirit inspires where he wills.
but you do not know where he comes from,
sic est omnis qui natus est ex spiritu.
So it is with all who are born of the Spirit.”
“How are these things able to be accomplished?”
and you are ignorant of these things?
that we speak about what we know,
et quod vidimus testamur, et testimonium nostrum non accipitis.
and we testify about what we have seen. But you do not accept our testimony.
If I have spoken to you about earthly things,
and you have not believed, then how will you believe,
if I will speak to you about heavenly things?
And no one has ascended to heaven,
except the one who descended from heaven:
Filius hominis, qui est in cælo.
the Son of man who is in heaven.
Et sicut Moyses exaltavit serpentem in deserto,
And just as Moses lifted up the serpent in the desert,
so also must the Son of man be lifted up,
ut omnis qui credit in ipsum, non pereat,
so that whoever believes in him may not perish,
Sic enim Deus dilexit mundum, ut Filium suum unigenitum daret:
For God so loved the world that he gave his only-begotten Son,
ut omnis qui credit in eum, non pereat,
so that all who believe in him may not perish,
Non enim misit Deus Filium suum in mundum,
For God did not send his Son into the world,
in order to judge the world,
sed ut salvetur mundus per ipsum.
but in order that the world may be saved through him.
Qui credit in eum, non judicatur;
Whoever believes in him is not judged.
qui autem non credit, jam judicatus est:
But whoever does not believe is already judged,
quia non credit in nomine unigeniti Filii Dei.
because he does not believe in the name of the only-begotten Son of God.
that the Light has come into the world,
et dilexerunt homines magis tenebras quam lucem:
and men loved darkness more than light.
Omnis enim qui male agit, odit lucem, et non venit ad lucem,
For everyone who does evil hates the Light and does not go toward the Light,
so that his works may not be corrected.
qui autem facit veritatem, venit ad lucem,
But whoever acts in truth goes toward the Light,
so that his works may be manifested,
because they have been accomplished in God.”
Post hæc venit Jesus et discipuli ejus in terram Judæam:
Jesus and his disciples went into the land of Judea.
And he was living there with them and baptizing.
because there was much water in that place.
Nondum enim missus fuerat Joannes in carcerem.
For John had not yet been cast into prison.
Facta est autem quæstio ex discipulis Joannis cum Judæis de purificatione.
Then a dispute occurred between the disciples of John and the Jews, about purification.
Et venerunt ad Joannem, et dixerunt ei:
And they went to John and said to him: “Rabbi,
Rabbi, qui erat tecum trans Jordanem,
the one who was with you across the Jordan,
ecce hic baptizat, et omnes veniunt ad eum.
behold, he is baptizing and everyone is going to him.”
“A man is not able to receive anything,
nisi fuerit ei datum de cælo.
unless it has been given to him from heaven.
Ipsi vos mihi testimonium perhibetis, quod dixerim:
You yourselves offer testimony for me that I said,
sed quia missus sum ante illum.
but that I have been sent before him.
He who holds the bride is the groom.
But the friend of the groom,
who stands and listens to Him,
rejoices joyfully at the voice of the groom. And so,
Hoc ergo gaudium meum impletum est.
this, my joy, has been fulfilled.
and he speaks about the earth.
Qui de cælo venit, super omnes est.
He who comes from heaven is above everything.
And no one accepts his testimony.
Qui accepit ejus testimonium signavit, quia Deus verax est.
Whoever has accepted his testimony has certified that God is truthful.
Quem enim misit Deus, verba Dei loquitur:
For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God.
non enim ad mensuram dat Deus spiritum.
For God does not give the Spirit by measure.
et omnia dedit in manu ejus.
and he has given everything into his hand.
Qui credit in Filium, habet vitam æternam;
Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life.
qui autem incredulus est Filio, non videbit vitam,
But whoever is unbelieving toward the Son shall not see life;
sed ira Dei manet super eum.
instead the wrath of God remains upon him.”
